issues: Train/test feature asymmetry: kNN features use leave-one-out similarities for training rows (diagonal set to -1.0) but the full training set for test rows, so the max-similarity column s[:,0] has different distributions at fit and predict time. Not leakage, but a mild calibration hazard.

Low statistical power: 1 candidate run vs 1 incumbent run gives se ~0.0099; z = -0.12 is a tie, not evidence the change hurts. Reject is defensible on the 'simpler is better' rule (added kernel/kNN code for no measurable gain) rather than on the numbers.
minmax_kernel is used but not defined in the diff; it is assumed to pre-exist in the incumbent file. Verified only indirectly by the fact that the job returned a score.
